answer: The fable schedule is applied in ocean and marble reveals each instalment. A payout is split which means 43% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1512 identities would post 2094 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
